a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, half-up half-down copper red hair — wearing a skin-tight micro summer school uniform set, a cropped camisole top of ultra-thin glossy pale-pink silk satin with thin spaghetti straps, a lace-trimmed neckline and a small ribbon bow at the center of its neckline, her shoulders and arms bare, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the silk satin fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin glossy cream silk satin with a thin pink stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.

Background: a green football stadium pitch with white line markings and packed stands rising behind; her giant stiletto heel stands in the foreground like a monument, with hundreds of tiny fans and tiny players in team shirts, small flags, and a tiny photographer team gathered in a crowd around the base of the heel, every person at their true real size and only as tall as the heel is long, all looking up at it; she is a colossal giant, her towering heels planted on the center circle of the pitch, her body rising high above the crowd and the buildings, a bright blue sky with soft clouds behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright clear daylight with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from ground level with the camera low among the crowd and tilted upward, her giant stiletto shoe and its slender heel large in the foreground at the bottom of the frame, the whole figure from the heel tips up to the top of her head completely visible rising far above the crowd, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
